desc:
🔥 How well do you REALLY know anime? 🔥

A character's art zooms in. 7 names. One is right. Pick fast and outlast your rival!

⚔️ 1v1 DUELS – Sit at a table, face a real player, and lose a heart for every wrong or slow pick. Last one with hearts wins.
🤝 2v2 – Team up with a friend and take on another duo.
💣 PARTY MODE – 3 to 5 players pass the bomb around the table. Pick the right character before the fuse runs out… and the fuse gets shorter every turn!
🤖 SOLO – Practice against the bot on Easy, Normal or Hard.

📚 300+ characters from Naruto, One Piece, Dragon Ball, Jujutsu Kaisen, Demon Slayer, Blue Lock, Haikyuu and many more. Can you fill your Index?

🎁 Open crates for chair skins, poses and hype moves
🏆 Grab the Champion Belt when it drops every 10 minutes
📅 Daily rewards and quests

Think you're the biggest anime fan? Prove it! 👇
